epoch-evolution.description: EPOCH evolution graph MCP server. Exposes mutation history, invariant status, trajectory snapshot, active workflows, and causal chain queries to Bob IDE.

tools.name: get_mutation_history
tools.description: Get recent mutations for a component or all components

parameters.component: Component name or '*' for all components
parameters.limit: Maximum number of mutations to return (default: 10)

tools.name: check_invariants
tools.description: Check the current status of invariants for specified components

tools.name: get_trajectory_snapshot
tools.description: Get the current system trajectory snapshot: coupling score, boundary integrity, drift findings

tools.name: list_active_workflows
tools.description: List all currently active WEAVE workflows and their states

tools.name: get_causal_chain
tools.description: Run causal archaeology from a symptom description to find the earliest plausible mutation

parameters.symptom: Description of the drift finding or incident to trace backward
